name: number-field
title: Number field
description: A number you step, scrub or type: keycaps at each end of a pill well; each step turns the value one drum step (plus up, minus down) and an arrow past a limit shakes only the digits.
docs: Agent guide: https://metalui.dev/r/number-field.md. SwiftUI: MetalNumberField in the MetalUI Swift package.
